fragments.text: אֲהַלְלָה אֱלֹהַי. אָשִׁירָה עֻזּוֹ. אֲסַפְּרָה כְבוֹדוֹ. אֲאַפְּדֶנּוּ מְלוּכָה:
אֲשַׂגֵּב לְפוֹעֵל. אֲשֶׁר שָׂח וּפָעַל. אֲנַוֵּהוּ. כִּי לוֹ יָאֲתָה מְלוּכָה:
בְּעֻזּוֹ נֶצַח אֲשַׁנֵּן. כִּי צְבָאוֹ אָנִי. וְלִי נָאֶה שִׂיחַ. גֹּדֶל הַמְּלוּכָה:
בְּקָהָל אֲבַשֵּׂר. בְּרֹב עָם אֲדַבֵּר. לְמִי שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָז. וּלְמִי הַמְּלוּכָה:
גּוֹשׁוּ גּוֹיִם. וּבֹאוּ מַמְלָכוֹת. רְאוּ מַה נֶהְדָּר. בְּמֵצַח הַמְּלוּכָה:
גַּדְּלוּהוּ אִתִּי. וּנְרוֹמְמֶנְהוּ יַחַד. וְאַל תִּתְגָּאוּ. בְּנֵזֶר הַמְּלוּכָה:
דְּרָכִים בְּעֵת. נֶעֶשְׂתָה מְצוּלָה. הִתְבּוֹנְנוּ יַחַד. לְמִי נִזְרְקָה מְלוּכָה:
דָּרַךְ סוּס בַּיָּם. כְּנֶגֶד שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב. וּמַה יוֹעִיל גֶּבֶר. עֹז בִּמְלוּכָה:
הֶאֱזִינוּ רוֹזְנִים. אָז וַיִּרְגָּזוּ. הִבִּיטוּ חֲתַת. וּמָאֲסוּ מְלוּכָה:
הִגִּידוּ כֹחוֹ. לְאֻמִּים וְדִבֵּרוּ. לָזֶה יִכָּתֵב. שֵׁם הַמְּלוּכָה:
וְנִלְחַם רֵאשִׁית. גּוֹיִם
וְאָבַד. כִּי נִשְׁבַּע חַי. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה:
וַיִּלְעַג בְּכָל דּוֹר. כִּי לֹא לָמַד. מִי נִלְחַם בַּיָּם. וְעָטָה מְלוּכָה:
זָד עַל אֲדוֹנָיו. עֶבֶד יֹשֵׁב נֶגֶב. בְּזֹאת תִּרְגַּז אֶרֶץ. בִּשְׂאֵת עֶבֶד מְלוּכָה:
זֶרַע בְּרוּכִים. הֶחֱרִימוּ אֲרוּרִים. כִּי נָתְנוּ קוֹל. לְאַדִּיר בִּמְלוּכָה:
חֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבָשָׁן. עוֹרְרוּ מִלְחֶמֶת. בְּלִי לָתֵת דֶּרֶךְ. לְצִבְאוֹת מְלוּכָה:
חֵילָם נִשְׁמַד. וְאַרְצָם חֻלָּקָה. וּמֵעַל זְרוּעָם. נָפְלָה מְלוּכָה:
טָפְשׁוּ בְּנֵי כְנַעַן. כִּי נָכְרִים הֵם. בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי שֵׁם. זֶרַע מְלוּכָה:
טְבָחָם בִּן נוּן. עַד פִּנָּה אֶרֶץ. לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית. אֲדוֹן הַמְּלוּכָה:
יוֹשְׁבֵי חֲרוֹשֶׁת. אָז הִקְשָׁה לַחַץ. עֲזָרוּהוּ בְּלִי בֶצַע. אַפְסֵי מְלוּכָה:
יָהּ נִלְחַם בָּם. צָבָא בְּלִי בֶצַע. כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ שְׁאָר. וְלָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה:
כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן. אַשּׁוּר גָּדַל. וְחֵרֵף אוֹרִיד.
כַּבִּיר הַמְּלוּכָה:
כְּלִיל אֵשׁ הֲמָמָם. בְּלֵיל שִׁמּוּרִים. וְאָז יָדְעוּ כֹל. כִּי לָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה:
לַשַּׁחַת כָּרַע בֵּל. כְּחָשְׁבוֹ עֲלוֹת לַשַּׁחַק. וְסָר מֶנּוּ לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ. וְרָד הַמְּלוּכָה:
לְכַנּוֹ הוּשַׁב. וְכֹחַ אֵל הִכִּיר. לְמֵרִים וּמַשְׁפִּיל. הִשְׁלִים מְלוּכָה:
מֻגָּרָה צֹאן לָטֶבַח. וְנִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִילוֹת. בִּלְבוּשׁ צָעִיר. רֹדֶם הַמְּלוּכָה:
מְכוּרֵי בְלֹא הוֹן. פְּדוּיֵי בְלֹא כֶסֶף. סֹלּוּ לְמַטֵּה כַּמַּיִם. לֵב הַמְּלוּכָה:
נִמְכְּרוּ יוֹנִים. לִבְנֵי יְוָנִים. וְרִחֲקוּם מֵעַל גְּבוּל מְלוּכָה:
נֵאֲרוּ בְּרִית וָדָת. וְהִמְרִידוּ עָם בָּאֵל. וּמִגְּרוּם בְּלֹא כֹחַ. מְכַהֲנֵי מְלוּכָה:
שָׂעִיר הֶחֱנִיף. לְהוֹרֵהוּ בְּצֵדוֹ. וַיִּירַשׁ בְּקוֹל בֶּכִי. חֶרֶב וּמְלוּכָה:
שֻׂגַּב חָלָק. הֱיוֹת גְּבִיר לְאֶחָיו. וְעוֹד תִּסּוֹב. לִישֻׁרוּן מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ
וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
עֲשֵׂה לְךָ בְּצִיּוֹן. שֵׁם נוֹרָאת. כְּאָז תַּצְלִיחֶנָּה. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה:
עוֹרֵר וְהָקֵץ. מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. וְכוֹנֵן כִּסְאֲךָ. בְּקִרְיַת מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ.
יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. הַר צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב:
פְּנֵי מְאוֹר לְבָנָה. וְחַמָּה תַּחְפִּיר. וְיֵבוֹשׁוּ עוֹבְדֵימוֹ. בִּשְׂאֵתְךָ מְלוּכָה:
פָּאֵר עִיר יוֹפִי. לְבָרָה כַּחַמָּה. וְגַלֵּה לְנֶגְדֵּנוּ. כְּבוֹד מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ.
וְחָפְרָה הַלְּבָנָה וּבוֹשָׁה הַחַמָּה כִּי מָלַךְ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בְּהַר צִיּוֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלַֽ͏ִם וְנֶגֶד זְקֵנָיו כָּבוֹד:
צִבְאוֹת גְּאוּלֵי צֹעַן. שׁוֹרְרוּ בְּלֵיל חַג. וְהוּא לַיְלָה נִשְׁמַר. לְסַחֵף מְלוּכָה:
צָעֲדוּ בְּמֵי שַׁעַל. צָפוּ בְּרוּחַ שֵׂכֶל. אָנָה יִנָּטְעוּ וִיקַבְּלוּ מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ
תְּבִאֵמוֹ וְתִטָּעֵמוֹ בְּהַר נַחֲלָתְךָ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ פָּעַלְתָּ יְיָ מִקְּדָשׁ אֲדֹנָי כּוֹנְנוּ יָדֶיךָ:
וְנֶאֱמַר
יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
קָמְטוּ שַׁעֲרֵי זְבוּל. בֵּית עוֹלָמִים. כִּי מִבֵּינֵימוֹ. שָׁבְתָה מְלוּכָה:
קָדוֹשׁ יָבֹא בָם. לְעֹלָמִים. וְאָז יִשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ. בְּחַדְּשׁוֹ מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב
שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד:
מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְיָ גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה:
וְנֶאֱמַר
שְׂעוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד:
מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה:
רָבְצָה עֲדִינָה. שָׁקְדָה מֵאַלְמוֹן. כִּי אָרַךְ לָהּ. קֵץ הַמְּלוּכָה:
רִיבוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים. שְׂאוּ אֶדֶר מֵאֱדוֹם. וְשִׁית עַל אָדוֹן. הוֹד הַמְּלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ
וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה:
שָׁוְא שָׂנֵא אֵל. וְהוּא עַל לְשׁוֹנֵנוּ. בִּקֵּשׁ אֱמֶת וָאָיִן. וְרָחֲקָה מְלוּכָה:
שַׁדַּי הָסֵר אָוֶן מִצְּבָאֶךָ. וְיָרִיעוּ לְךָ. תְּרוּעַת מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ
לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ:
תַּחְגּוֹר גֵּאוּת. תִּתְאַזַּר עֹז. לְבַל יִשְׂתָּרֵר. זָר בִּמְלוּכָה:
תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל. כִּי יְנֻעַר רָשָׁע. וְשָׂם צֶדֶק לְרַגְלָיו. וְיִצְנוֹף מְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ
יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט:
תִּקּוֹם גּוֹיִם. תּוֹכִיחַ לְאֻמִּים. תִּשְׁבּוֹר מַטֵּה רֶשַׁע. מוֹשֵׁל הַמְּלוּכָה:
תַּחֲלִיף אֱלִילִים. תִּשָּׂגֵב לְבַדֶּךָ. תִּקָּרֵא נֶצַח. יָחִיד בִּמְלוּכָה:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ
וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:
I praise my God, sing of His might, tell of His honour, I crown Him with a kingdom.
I will exalt the Creator who spoke and created, I will glorify Him for the kingdom becomes Him.
His might shall I ever repeat for I am of His host, and for me it is fitting to speak of the grandeur of the kingdom.
In assembly do I proclaim, before a multitude of people do I announce whose is loftiness and might and whose is the kingdom.
Approach, O nations, and come, O kingdoms, behold how glorious He is with the diadem of the kingdom.
Call Him great with me, together let us exalt Him, do not behave proudly with the crown of the kingdom.
When paths were laid through the depths of the sea, they all understood to whom was granted the kingdom.
His horse walked through the sea against six hundred chariots of war, what did might avail man against the kingdom.
Princes heard and then trembled, they looked around in dread and abdicated their kingdom.
Peoples told of His power and said: to Him shall be written the name of the kingdom.
The first people (Amalek)
to fight fought and perished, for the Lord had sworn by the throne of the kingdom.
Amalek earned shame in every generation since he had not learned who fought at the sea and was clothed in the kingdom.
The slave, who lived in the south, presumed against his master, whereupon the earth trembled when the slave took the kingdom.
The seed of the blessed (Israel) destroyed the accursed since they raised their voice against Him who is glorious in kingdom.
Heshbon and Bashan stirred up war for they would not grant passage to the hosts of the kingdom.
Their army was annihilated, their land was divided and their seed was deprived of a kingdom.
The Canaanites were foolish for they had been strangers on the soil of the sons of Shem, the seed of the kingdom.
The son of Nun slew them until he cleared the land before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the kingdom.
The man of Harosheth was hard in oppression, there helped him without pay those far from the kingdom.
The Lord fought against them with a Host without payment, may the rest perish likewise and to God be the kingdom.
Like the cedar on Lebanon did Assyria grow great and blasphemed: ‘In my might I will bring down the kingdom’.
When the ray of fire destroyed them in the night of vigil, then all could perceive
that to God was the kingdom.
Bel sank into ruin when he planned to rise to heaven, human reason left him and he descended from the kingdom.
When restored to his place, he acknowledged God’s power, to Him who raises and lowers, he delivered the kingdom.
Like sheep to the slaughter was it (Israel) to be driven, then was God’s work accomplished by the youngest tribe (Benjamin from whom Esther was descended) through the power of the kingdom.
You who were sold without a price (Israel) will be redeemed without silver, prepare the way for Him who turns like water the heart of the kingdom.
The doves (Israel) were sold to the Greeks and they banished them from the frontier of the kingdom.
Covenant and law were broken, they caused the people to rebel against God, then powerless were they crushed by the priests of the kingdom.
The hairy one flattered his father with his venison and through the sound of weeping inherited sword and kingdom.
Exalted will be the smooth one, becoming master to his brothers and once again will return to Yeshurun the kingdom.
As it is written in Thy Torah:
He was King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel.
Make for Thyself in Zion an awe-inspiring name, prosper it as of old with the throne of the kingdom.
Arouse and revive the delight of the whole earth (Jerusalem) and establish Thy throne in the city of the kingdom.
As it is written in Thy holy words:
a beautiful branch, the delight of the whole earth, the mountain of Zion, the stronghold of the North, the city of the great King.
The light of the moon and of the sun wilt Thou cause to blush and those who worship them will be put to shame when Thou dost lift up the kingdom.
Glorify the city of beauty, that it may be bright as the sun and reveal in front of us the glory of the kingdom.
As it is written through Thy prophet:
and the moon shall blush and the sun be ashamed, for the Lord of Hosts rules on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem and in front of His elders there is glory.
The hosts redeemed from Egypt sang on the night of the feast, this is the night preserved for the devastation of a kingdom;
they stepped through the waters of the sea, they looked with a spirit of insight to the place where they were to be planted and receive the kingdom.
As it is written in Thy Torah:
‘Thou wilt bring them and plant them upon the mount of Thine inheritance, the site for Thy dwelling which Thou hast made, O Lord, the sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established’.
And it was said:
‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever’.
Destroyed are the gates of the temple, the House of eternity, for there has ceased from among them the Kingdom.
The Holy One will return to them for ever; then will they raise their heads again when He renews the kingdom.
As it is written:
‘Lift up your heads, O gates, and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, mighty and strong, the Lord, mighty in war’.
And it was said:
‘Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’.
The voluptuous one (Babel) sprawled at ease, she did not fear widowhood, for far from her was the end of the kingdom.
Struggle, deliverers, take the royal gown from Edom and adorn the Lord with the splendour of the Kingdom.
As it was written through Thy prophet:
Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s.
God hates falsehood, yet it is upon our tongue; He demands truth, but it is not there; and, therefore, distant became the Kingdom.
Almighty, remove guilt from Thy hosts that they may cry out to Thee with the Teruah of the Kingdom.
As it is written in Thy Torah:
And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel. The Lord, his God, is with him, and the royal Teruah is within him.
Gird Thyself in loftiness, surround Thyself with strength, so that no stranger may rule over the Kingdom.
The world will be firm when the wicked is shaken off, the Lord will set justice beneath Him and put on the crown of the Kingdom.
As it is written in Thy holy words:
The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter.
Thou wilt take vengeance on nations, Thou wilt rebuke peoples, Thou wilt break the staff of evil, ruling over the Kingdom.
Thou wilt make idols disappear, Thou alone wilt be exalted, Thou wilt be invoked for ever, unique in the Kingdom.
As it is written through Thy prophet:
The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His name One.
And it is written in Thy Torah:
Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.

rows.he: אֲהַלְלָה אֱלֹהַי. אָשִׁירָה עֻזּוֹ. אֲסַפְּרָה כְבוֹדוֹ. אֲאַפְּדֶנּוּ מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: I praise my God, sing of His might, tell of His honour, I crown Him with a kingdom.

rows.he: אֲשַׂגֵּב לְפוֹעֵל. אֲשֶׁר שָׂח וּפָעַל. אֲנַוֵּהוּ. כִּי לוֹ יָאֲתָה מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: I will exalt the Creator who spoke and created, I will glorify Him for the kingdom becomes Him.

rows.he: בְּעֻזּוֹ נֶצַח אֲשַׁנֵּן. כִּי צְבָאוֹ אָנִי. וְלִי נָאֶה שִׂיחַ. גֹּדֶל הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: His might shall I ever repeat for I am of His host, and for me it is fitting to speak of the grandeur of the kingdom.

rows.he: בְּקָהָל אֲבַשֵּׂר. בְּרֹב עָם אֲדַבֵּר. לְמִי שְׂאֵת וְיֶתֶר עָז. וּלְמִי הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: In assembly do I proclaim, before a multitude of people do I announce whose is loftiness and might and whose is the kingdom.

rows.he: גּוֹשׁוּ גּוֹיִם. וּבֹאוּ מַמְלָכוֹת. רְאוּ מַה נֶהְדָּר. בְּמֵצַח הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Approach, O nations, and come, O kingdoms, behold how glorious He is with the diadem of the kingdom.

rows.he: גַּדְּלוּהוּ אִתִּי. וּנְרוֹמְמֶנְהוּ יַחַד. וְאַל תִּתְגָּאוּ. בְּנֵזֶר הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Call Him great with me, together let us exalt Him, do not behave proudly with the crown of the kingdom.

rows.he: דְּרָכִים בְּעֵת. נֶעֶשְׂתָה מְצוּלָה. הִתְבּוֹנְנוּ יַחַד. לְמִי נִזְרְקָה מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: When paths were laid through the depths of the sea, they all understood to whom was granted the kingdom.

rows.he: דָּרַךְ סוּס בַּיָּם. כְּנֶגֶד שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב. וּמַה יוֹעִיל גֶּבֶר. עֹז בִּמְלוּכָה:
rows.en: His horse walked through the sea against six hundred chariots of war, what did might avail man against the kingdom.

rows.he: הֶאֱזִינוּ רוֹזְנִים. אָז וַיִּרְגָּזוּ. הִבִּיטוּ חֲתַת. וּמָאֲסוּ מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Princes heard and then trembled, they looked around in dread and abdicated their kingdom.

rows.he: הִגִּידוּ כֹחוֹ. לְאֻמִּים וְדִבֵּרוּ. לָזֶה יִכָּתֵב. שֵׁם הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Peoples told of His power and said: to Him shall be written the name of the kingdom.

rows.he: וְנִלְחַם רֵאשִׁית. גּוֹיִם וְאָבַד. כִּי נִשְׁבַּע חַי. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The first people (Amalek) to fight fought and perished, for the Lord had sworn by the throne of the kingdom.

rows.he: וַיִּלְעַג בְּכָל דּוֹר. כִּי לֹא לָמַד. מִי נִלְחַם בַּיָּם. וְעָטָה מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Amalek earned shame in every generation since he had not learned who fought at the sea and was clothed in the kingdom.

rows.he: זָד עַל אֲדוֹנָיו. עֶבֶד יֹשֵׁב נֶגֶב. בְּזֹאת תִּרְגַּז אֶרֶץ. בִּשְׂאֵת עֶבֶד מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The slave, who lived in the south, presumed against his master, whereupon the earth trembled when the slave took the kingdom.

rows.he: זֶרַע בְּרוּכִים. הֶחֱרִימוּ אֲרוּרִים. כִּי נָתְנוּ קוֹל. לְאַדִּיר בִּמְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The seed of the blessed (Israel) destroyed the accursed since they raised their voice against Him who is glorious in kingdom.

rows.he: חֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבָשָׁן. עוֹרְרוּ מִלְחֶמֶת. בְּלִי לָתֵת דֶּרֶךְ. לְצִבְאוֹת מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Heshbon and Bashan stirred up war for they would not grant passage to the hosts of the kingdom.

rows.he: חֵילָם נִשְׁמַד. וְאַרְצָם חֻלָּקָה. וּמֵעַל זְרוּעָם. נָפְלָה מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Their army was annihilated, their land was divided and their seed was deprived of a kingdom.

rows.he: טָפְשׁוּ בְּנֵי כְנַעַן. כִּי נָכְרִים הֵם. בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי שֵׁם. זֶרַע מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The Canaanites were foolish for they had been strangers on the soil of the sons of Shem, the seed of the kingdom.

rows.he: טְבָחָם בִּן נוּן. עַד פִּנָּה אֶרֶץ. לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן הַבְּרִית. אֲדוֹן הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: The son of Nun slew them until he cleared the land before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the kingdom.

rows.he: יוֹשְׁבֵי חֲרוֹשֶׁת. אָז הִקְשָׁה לַחַץ. עֲזָרוּהוּ בְּלִי בֶצַע. אַפְסֵי מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The man of Harosheth was hard in oppression, there helped him without pay those far from the kingdom.

rows.he: יָהּ נִלְחַם בָּם. צָבָא בְּלִי בֶצַע. כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ שְׁאָר. וְלָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: The Lord fought against them with a Host without payment, may the rest perish likewise and to God be the kingdom.

rows.he: כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן. אַשּׁוּר גָּדַל. וְחֵרֵף אוֹרִיד. כַּבִּיר הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Like the cedar on Lebanon did Assyria grow great and blasphemed: ‘In my might I will bring down the kingdom’.

rows.he: כְּלִיל אֵשׁ הֲמָמָם. בְּלֵיל שִׁמּוּרִים. וְאָז יָדְעוּ כֹל. כִּי לָאֵל הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: When the ray of fire destroyed them in the night of vigil, then all could perceive that to God was the kingdom.

rows.he: לַשַּׁחַת כָּרַע בֵּל. כְּחָשְׁבוֹ עֲלוֹת לַשַּׁחַק. וְסָר מֶנּוּ לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ. וְרָד הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Bel sank into ruin when he planned to rise to heaven, human reason left him and he descended from the kingdom.

rows.he: לְכַנּוֹ הוּשַׁב. וְכֹחַ אֵל הִכִּיר. לְמֵרִים וּמַשְׁפִּיל. הִשְׁלִים מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: When restored to his place, he acknowledged God’s power, to Him who raises and lowers, he delivered the kingdom.

rows.he: מֻגָּרָה צֹאן לָטֶבַח. וְנִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִילוֹת. בִּלְבוּשׁ צָעִיר. רֹדֶם הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Like sheep to the slaughter was it (Israel) to be driven, then was God’s work accomplished by the youngest tribe (Benjamin from whom Esther was descended) through the power of the kingdom.

rows.he: מְכוּרֵי בְלֹא הוֹן. פְּדוּיֵי בְלֹא כֶסֶף. סֹלּוּ לְמַטֵּה כַּמַּיִם. לֵב הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: You who were sold without a price (Israel) will be redeemed without silver, prepare the way for Him who turns like water the heart of the kingdom.

rows.he: נִמְכְּרוּ יוֹנִים. לִבְנֵי יְוָנִים. וְרִחֲקוּם מֵעַל גְּבוּל מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The doves (Israel) were sold to the Greeks and they banished them from the frontier of the kingdom.

rows.he: נֵאֲרוּ בְּרִית וָדָת. וְהִמְרִידוּ עָם בָּאֵל. וּמִגְּרוּם בְּלֹא כֹחַ. מְכַהֲנֵי מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Covenant and law were broken, they caused the people to rebel against God, then powerless were they crushed by the priests of the kingdom.

rows.he: שָׂעִיר הֶחֱנִיף. לְהוֹרֵהוּ בְּצֵדוֹ. וַיִּירַשׁ בְּקוֹל בֶּכִי. חֶרֶב וּמְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The hairy one flattered his father with his venison and through the sound of weeping inherited sword and kingdom.

rows.he: שֻׂגַּב חָלָק. הֱיוֹת גְּבִיר לְאֶחָיו. וְעוֹד תִּסּוֹב. לִישֻׁרוּן מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Exalted will be the smooth one, becoming master to his brothers and once again will return to Yeshurun the kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף רָאשֵׁי עָם יַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
rows.en: As it is written in Thy Torah: He was King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel.

rows.he: עֲשֵׂה לְךָ בְּצִיּוֹן. שֵׁם נוֹרָאת. כְּאָז תַּצְלִיחֶנָּה. בְּכִסֵּא מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Make for Thyself in Zion an awe-inspiring name, prosper it as of old with the throne of the kingdom.

rows.he: עוֹרֵר וְהָקֵץ. מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. וְכוֹנֵן כִּסְאֲךָ. בְּקִרְיַת מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Arouse and revive the delight of the whole earth (Jerusalem) and establish Thy throne in the city of the kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ. יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ. הַר צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב:
rows.en: As it is written in Thy holy words: a beautiful branch, the delight of the whole earth, the mountain of Zion, the stronghold of the North, the city of the great King.

rows.he: פְּנֵי מְאוֹר לְבָנָה. וְחַמָּה תַּחְפִּיר. וְיֵבוֹשׁוּ עוֹבְדֵימוֹ. בִּשְׂאֵתְךָ מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The light of the moon and of the sun wilt Thou cause to blush and those who worship them will be put to shame when Thou dost lift up the kingdom.

rows.he: פָּאֵר עִיר יוֹפִי. לְבָרָה כַּחַמָּה. וְגַלֵּה לְנֶגְדֵּנוּ. כְּבוֹד מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Glorify the city of beauty, that it may be bright as the sun and reveal in front of us the glory of the kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ. וְחָפְרָה הַלְּבָנָה וּבוֹשָׁה הַחַמָּה כִּי מָלַךְ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בְּהַר צִיּוֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלַֽ͏ִם וְנֶגֶד זְקֵנָיו כָּבוֹד:
rows.en: As it is written through Thy prophet: and the moon shall blush and the sun be ashamed, for the Lord of Hosts rules on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem and in front of His elders there is glory.

rows.he: צִבְאוֹת גְּאוּלֵי צֹעַן. שׁוֹרְרוּ בְּלֵיל חַג. וְהוּא לַיְלָה נִשְׁמַר. לְסַחֵף מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The hosts redeemed from Egypt sang on the night of the feast, this is the night preserved for the devastation of a kingdom;

rows.he: צָעֲדוּ בְּמֵי שַׁעַל. צָפוּ בְּרוּחַ שֵׂכֶל. אָנָה יִנָּטְעוּ וִיקַבְּלוּ מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: they stepped through the waters of the sea, they looked with a spirit of insight to the place where they were to be planted and receive the kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ תְּבִאֵמוֹ וְתִטָּעֵמוֹ בְּהַר נַחֲלָתְךָ מָכוֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ פָּעַלְתָּ יְיָ מִקְּדָשׁ אֲדֹנָי כּוֹנְנוּ יָדֶיךָ:
rows.en: As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘Thou wilt bring them and plant them upon the mount of Thine inheritance, the site for Thy dwelling which Thou hast made, O Lord, the sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established’.

rows.he: וְנֶאֱמַר יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
rows.en: And it was said: ‘The Lord will reign for ever and ever’.

rows.he: קָמְטוּ שַׁעֲרֵי זְבוּל. בֵּית עוֹלָמִים. כִּי מִבֵּינֵימוֹ. שָׁבְתָה מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Destroyed are the gates of the temple, the House of eternity, for there has ceased from among them the Kingdom.

rows.he: קָדוֹשׁ יָבֹא בָם. לְעֹלָמִים. וְאָז יִשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ. בְּחַדְּשׁוֹ מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The Holy One will return to them for ever; then will they raise their heads again when He renews the kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד:
rows.en: As it is written: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates, and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter.

rows.he: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְיָ גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה:
rows.en: Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, mighty and strong, the Lord, mighty in war’.

rows.he: וְנֶאֱמַר שְׂעוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד:
rows.en: And it was said: ‘Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter.

rows.he: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְיָ צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה:
rows.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah’.

rows.he: רָבְצָה עֲדִינָה. שָׁקְדָה מֵאַלְמוֹן. כִּי אָרַךְ לָהּ. קֵץ הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: The voluptuous one (Babel) sprawled at ease, she did not fear widowhood, for far from her was the end of the kingdom.

rows.he: רִיבוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים. שְׂאוּ אֶדֶר מֵאֱדוֹם. וְשִׁית עַל אָדוֹן. הוֹד הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Struggle, deliverers, take the royal gown from Edom and adorn the Lord with the splendour of the Kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁיעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: As it was written through Thy prophet: Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord’s.

rows.he: שָׁוְא שָׂנֵא אֵל. וְהוּא עַל לְשׁוֹנֵנוּ. בִּקֵּשׁ אֱמֶת וָאָיִן. וְרָחֲקָה מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: God hates falsehood, yet it is upon our tongue; He demands truth, but it is not there; and, therefore, distant became the Kingdom.

rows.he: שַׁדַּי הָסֵר אָוֶן מִצְּבָאֶךָ. וְיָרִיעוּ לְךָ. תְּרוּעַת מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Almighty, remove guilt from Thy hosts that they may cry out to Thee with the Teruah of the Kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ לֹא הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ:
rows.en: As it is written in Thy Torah: And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel. The Lord, his God, is with him, and the royal Teruah is within him.

rows.he: תַּחְגּוֹר גֵּאוּת. תִּתְאַזַּר עֹז. לְבַל יִשְׂתָּרֵר. זָר בִּמְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Gird Thyself in loftiness, surround Thyself with strength, so that no stranger may rule over the Kingdom.

rows.he: תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל. כִּי יְנֻעַר רָשָׁע. וְשָׂם צֶדֶק לְרַגְלָיו. וְיִצְנוֹף מְלוּכָה:
rows.en: The world will be firm when the wicked is shaken off, the Lord will set justice beneath Him and put on the crown of the Kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל תִּמּוֹט:
rows.en: As it is written in Thy holy words: The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter.

rows.he: תִּקּוֹם גּוֹיִם. תּוֹכִיחַ לְאֻמִּים. תִּשְׁבּוֹר מַטֵּה רֶשַׁע. מוֹשֵׁל הַמְּלוּכָה:
rows.en: Thou wilt take vengeance on nations, Thou wilt rebuke peoples, Thou wilt break the staff of evil, ruling over the Kingdom.

rows.he: תַּחֲלִיף אֱלִילִים. תִּשָּׂגֵב לְבַדֶּךָ. תִּקָּרֵא נֶצַח. יָחִיד בִּמְלוּכָה:
rows.en: Thou wilt make idols disappear, Thou alone wilt be exalted, Thou wilt be invoked for ever, unique in the Kingdom.

rows.he: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
rows.en: As it is written through Thy prophet: The Lord will be King over the whole earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His name One.

rows.he: וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד:
rows.en: And it is written in Thy Torah: Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.
